name: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited
summary: Khazanchi Jewellers Limited specializes in the creation and retail of a diverse array of jewelry. Their offerings encompass elegant gold and dazzling diamond pieces, along with items crafted from precious stones and other decorative designs. Additionally, the company trades in bullion, available as coins and bars. This enterprise commenced operations on March 25, 1996, and maintains its principal place of business in Chennai, India.
